title: Generation
description: One thing a model wrote when somebody asked for it: what was asked, what it was given to read, and the text that came out. The assets it read are named by id and stay where they are — this record is the asking, not a copy of the material.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

session.description: The working session it was generated in, by that session's id in the system that holds it. A session, not a person: who was at the keyboard is the session's own business. Absent when it was generated outside one.

generationType.description: What kind of thing was asked for. Free text: the vocabulary grows with every surface that asks, so it is not closed here.

assetIds.description: The assets the model was given to read, by their ids in the system that holds them. Ids, never the material: the asset is somebody else's record.

instructions.description: What the person asked for, in their own words, before anything was assembled around it.

output.description: The text the model produced. Empty while the generation exists and has produced nothing yet.

modelUsed.description: Which model wrote it, under the name its provider gives it. Recorded so a later reading knows what produced the text — never a key, never a provider credential.

channel.description: Where the text was meant to go. Free text: the channels belong to whoever publishes, not to this shape.

objective.description: What the text was meant to achieve. Free text, for the same reason as channel.

promptUsed.description: The prompt actually sent, after the instructions and the context were assembled into one. Kept because the instructions alone do not reproduce it.

contentStatus.description: Where the text stands. Which status may follow which is a rule held by the system that moves it, not a constraint of this shape.

tags.description: Labels somebody put on it. Free text, theirs.
